system.description:
Brings everything to dust quickly: destroy an object on the spot, or call the 'House Pox' down on a house's holdings.

Spell. Destruction: Difficulty from the object's weight on the Strength table, +1 step for stone or soft metal, +2 for steel; must also beat a wearer's Sorcery Defense. Greater Action at Close Range: the object crumbles to dust, rust and shards.

Ritual. Alignment: Disaster: Challenging (9) Knowledge, time varies, placing talismans around the target holding. Invocation: Formidable (12) Will, 3 hours. Unleashing: Formidable (12) Will: ruin falls on a house's holding.

Art of Malediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 103.
system.resonances: None (spell), or a link to the target (ritual).
